props.gloss_en: a person may say to his fellow [on Shabbat]: 'to such-and-such a city I am going tomorrow'
for if there are burganin, he [may] go
one may not wait at dusk at the Shabbat boundary to hire workers or to bring produce
granted, for hiring workers: on Shabbat he cannot hire
you find it [the produce clause] with produce attached [to the ground]
R' Oshaya taught: one may not wait at dusk at the boundary to bring hay and straw
granted, straw -- you find it when attached
[hay -- you find it] with rotten hay
one may wait at dusk at the boundary to attend to the affairs of a bride and the affairs of the dead
for the affairs of a bride and the dead, yes; for the affairs of another, no
granted, 'another' like the bride -- you find it in cutting him myrtle
but the dead -- what is it? to bring him a coffin and shrouds
the dead too -- you find it in cutting him a garment

objections.gloss_en: תנן: אין מחשיכין על התחום... להביא פירות -- לימא: שאם יש שם מחיצות מביא! -- by Shmuel's logic, waiting to bring produce should be permitted, since with partitions he could bring it
והתני רבי אושעיא: אין מחשיכין על התחום להביא תבן וקש. בשלמא קש משכחת לה במחובר, אלא תבן היכי משכחת לה?
תא שמע: מחשיכין על התחום לפקח על עסקי כלה ועל עסקי המת -- אחר לא; מת מאי ניהו? להביא לו ארון ותכריכין... ואמאי? לימא: שאם יש שם מחיצות מביא! (150b.8-10)
